explanations.en: Ready is the original quoted message. Return to Predict and read the letters inside the quotes.
The quotes mark the message in the code. Return to Run and compare the code with the printed output.
One output statement runs once. Follow the two trace steps and count the printed lines.
The quoted text supplies the message. Open Modify and change only that text.
Editing changes the program, not an earlier result. Run it again to see the new output.
